Last updated: 2026-10-07

A blank upstream cell means no exact counterpart was established by the conservative name-and-arity mapper; it does not claim an intentional extension. Review each against the linked Godot class page and record a rationale before declaring parity.

Native SDL-dummy FAudio PCM checks cue start/restart/stop and departed nonblended output; two GPU and two compatibility Wayland hosts verify six actual pixel poses and borrowed-resource cleanup. Native allocator internals, physical listening, other platforms, disk/editor and human acceptance remain unverified. (class reference). |

| — | [`public override System.String[] GetConfigurationWarnings()`](../classes/CanvasItem.md) | Implemented | Electron2D-specific: Pinned canvas_item.cpp/.h, renderer_canvas_cull.cpp and renderer_canvas_render_rd.cpp audit: stored Disabled/Only/AndDraw with Max sentinel, equal-write silence and commit-before-warning refresh; drawn command/texture/tint alpha masks same-Z descendants over the copied background. No recorded commands or no captured child range preserve ordinary drawing. CanvasGroup stores policy without replacing its group mode. Physical-ancestor clipping/group warnings preserve the source boundary; nested same-Z masks/groups and writable screen reads explicitly reject under ADR 0028. CanvasClipTests verifies guards, callbacks, packing, native Wayland GPU/hardware compatibility pixels, texture/partial/overlap alpha, Y-sort, Z/TopLevel/neutral boundaries, transparent SubViewport/resize, custom HLSL/GLSL Only materials, and 64 active plus 64 idle warmed frames with zero managed bytes. Software advanced mask blending rejects before drawing. Native/driver allocations, other platforms, editor inspector hiding and owner visual acceptance remain separate gates. (class reference). |

| — | [`protected override System.Void Dispose(System.Boolean disposing)`](../classes/DTLSServer.md) | Implemented | Electron2D-specific: Typed construction/finalization/disposal or concrete inherited PacketPeer packet/availability/owner hook. ADR 0094 executable DTLS packets/server state: PacketPeerDTLS borrows connected PacketPeerUDP, DTLSServer prepares retained identity and address/scope/port-bound HMAC-SHA256 cookies; existing TLSOptions and shared TLSStatus under ADR 0051 preserve trust/name/role/error identities. Linux system OpenSSL 3.2+ fixed 64-KiB datagram BIO pairs implement DTLS1.2, complete record input/output, cookie challenges on the same logical peer and polled native retransmission timers. Preserve 488-byte advertised capacity, empty-send no-op, bounded whole-packet queues, undersized read preservation, generation/reentry/owner/security-resource cleanup. DTLSTests executes public Node/SceneTree/UDPServer packet workflow, first-hello loss/retry, cookie challenge, anti-replay/bad-MAC recovery, name/custom/system/unsafe trust, rollback/lifetime and independent OpenSSL CLI peers in both roles; 64 prepared active/idle cycles allocate zero managed bytes. Native OpenSSL allocation, foreign/browser/routed/performance, ENet and human/rendered/editor acceptance remain separate gates. (class reference). |

ADR 0094 complete native ENet host/peer/multiplayer slice: unchanged ENet 1.3.18 core, private routing-token IPv4/IPV6 socket port, typed events, exact channels/flags/statistics, five codecs, bounded packet queues and retained DTLS transport. Server/client/mesh integration preserves identity, channel zero mode separation, positive channels, actual metadata, targeting, relay capability and committed callback/lifetime semantics; channel upper-bound, server bandwidth/channel argument and timeout multiplier defects are corrected explicitly. ENetTests executes IPv4/IPV6, all codecs/fragmentation, DTLS, two-client routing/modes, mesh, SceneTree/SceneMultiplayer packets, tuning, refusal, datagram loss/retransmission, capacity and owner/reset/disposal edges; a separate stock Unix ENet process verifies the private socket-port wire. The complete SceneReplicationTests native spawn/sync/delta/visibility/RPC/cleanup scenario also executes over ENet; the asynchronous fixture waits for subsequent state separately from initial spawn readiness. Sixty-four prepared multiplayer and active replication/idle scene intervals allocate zero managed bytes. Native allocator/routed/browser/foreign-platform and human/rendered/editor acceptance remain separate gates. (class reference). |

| — | [`public override System.Void Close()`](../classes/WebSocketMultiplayerPeer.md) | Implemented | Electron2D-specific: Typed constructor, inherited span/lifecycle override, signal dispatch or metadata hook for multiplayer transports. ADR 0094 multiplayer transport delivery: typed owner-thread peer identity/lifecycle/routing/next-packet metadata and all managed extension hooks, Offline local authority and executable owned WS/WSS server/client cohorts. Four-byte little-endian binary identity precedes connection events; broadcast/positive/exclusion targeting, Reliable/channel zero actual metadata, admission/deadlines, bounded aggregate inbox/backpressure and deterministic cleanup execute. Callback fanout/errors/reentry are defined.
